name: Delure Inspired by Good Girl | Sweet & Seductive Women’s Perfume
description: Delure, inspired by the iconic Carolina Herrera Good Girl, is a sweet, bold, and irresistibly seductive women’s perfume designed for confident, modern women. The fragrance opens with a sparkling blend of almond, pear, and citrus nuances, creating an inviting and feminine introduction. As it develops, the scent reveals a luxurious floral heart of jasmine, tuberose, and orange blossom—rich, creamy, and elegant. The base unfolds with warm notes of tonka bean, cocoa, vanilla, and sandalwood, delivering a long-lasting, sensual finish. With its high perfume-oil concentration, Delure offers excellent longevity and projection, making it ideal for evenings, parties, romantic nights, and special occasions. Sweet, warm, and captivating, this fragrance beautifully represents the seductive charm of Good Girl—exclusively crafted by Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Almond, Pear, Citrus Accords Heart Notes: Jasmine, Tuberose, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Cocoa, Vanilla, Sandalwood Longevity: 8–10 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Perfect for parties, date nights, and evening wear Why Choose Delure? Inspired by the bestselling Carolina Herrera Good Girl Sweet, warm, and seductive fragrance profile Premium perfume oil concentration for better longevity Exclusive luxury women’s fragrance by Scents by Aamir
story: Delure, inspired by Good Girl, opens with almond and pear, blending into creamy florals and warm tonka bean to create a sweet, seductive, and long-lasting women’s fragrance.
